task_and_failure: Page-grounded document ingestion was unqualified; installed version evidence and unrelated retrieval benchmarks did not establish source-to-excerpt fidelity.
discovery_provenance: Maintained ecosystem catalog document/PDF lookup followed by current official release, license and compatibility review.
license_and_compatibility: Original MIT synthetic PDF plus unmodified public W3C test PDF with its notice. Poppler source is GPL; this repository redistributes no parser binary. Minimal macOS arm64 source build, exact locally reused dependency hashes.

baseline_and_candidate.baseline: Existing bundled Poppler 26.05.0 was version-inspected and used for visual QA; no matched text extraction baseline or efficiency experiment.
baseline_and_candidate.candidate: Latest Poppler 26.09.0 native coordinate extraction and scoped deterministic evidence retrieval.

predeclared_metrics.quality_rule: Exact page text, all table cells, positive source/page/provenance and four absent answers; bounded excerpts and native malformed-input refusal.
predeclared_metrics.usage_rule: No model/embedding/provider calls inside this deterministic native runner. Coordinator, preparation and research usage are outside scope and unknown; no savings claim.

runtime_and_platform.isolation: Owned prefix outside Documents with copied pinned libraries; no global settings, dependency mutation or service registration.

observations.scope: Three-page explicitly permitted born-digital corpus on one Mac; native text/page geometry, declared table templates and bounded exact-phrase retrieval

limitations: Only one small designed corpus; original passed attempt retained under history/attempt-1, followed by one passing rerun after source-list guard hardening. No held-out task or matched baseline.
Table geometry is predeclared; no automatic table detection, OCR, multilingual CMaps or semantic retrieval.
Build/preflight failures are retained separately; neither blocked version command constituted a native corpus extraction attempt.
Full upstream parser test suite was not run. Copied libraries are exact compatible pins, not claims every transitive library is latest.
Source checksums identify retained source bytes; detached Poppler signature was not verified.
The same-binary location workaround is observed on one Mac, not a general OS permission diagnosis.
No model calls within runner; research/coordinator costs unknown. No token or cost saving is claimed.

The earlier source list relied on reviewed fixture content; the current runner additionally refuses unlisted, absolute, traversal, duplicate and symlink sources before any process launch. Historical attempt bytes are retained; current freeze was set before rerun.

decision_and_scope.scope: Three-page explicitly permitted born-digital corpus on one Mac; native text/page geometry, declared table templates and bounded exact-phrase retrieval

rollback: Keep bundled parser intact; retain receipts and remove only the owned private candidate prefix when unused.
next_decision_changing_test: Freeze a permitted real report/multi-column/scanned corpus independently; measure failures before selecting a specialized Docling/OCR pipeline.
